drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel:
Counsel,

Please see our first-turn clean-up comments to the draft settlement agreement. We have focused on mechanics and standard settlement protections—payment timing, release effectiveness, confidentiality carve-outs, dismissal, authority, and no admission language. We think these changes should put the agreement in a form the parties can finalize promptly once the settlement amount and payee details are confirmed.

Best,
Aldous Finch LLP

edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to fully and finally resolve the Action and all claims, disputes, demands, causes of action, damages, costs, fees, and liabilities that were asserted or could have been asserted by Plaintiff arising out of or relating to the matters alleged in the Action, without any admission of liability or wrongdoing by Defendant.
edits.name: Recitals - scope of settlement

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff the total settlement amount of $[●] (the “Settlement Amount”) within ten (10) business days after Defendant’s receipt of: (a) a fully executed copy of this Agreement; (b) a completed IRS Form W-9 for the payee; and (c) written wire or payment instructions. Payment shall be made by wire transfer or other mutually agreed method. Plaintiff acknowledges that Defendant’s payment of the Settlement Amount constitutes full and complete consideration for this Agreement.
edits.name: Payment mechanics

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Effective upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff, on behalf of Plaintiff and Plaintiff’s heirs, executors, administrators, successors, assigns, agents, representatives, and anyone claiming through Plaintiff, fully and forever releases and discharges Defendant and Defendant’s past, present, and future parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, predecessors, successors, assigns, officers, directors, employees, agents, insurers, attorneys, and representatives from any and all claims, demands, causes of action, obligations, damages, costs, expenses, attorneys’ fees, and liabilities of any kind, whether known or unknown, suspected or unsuspected, arising out of or relating to the Action or the facts alleged therein. Plaintiff shall file a dismissal with prejudice of the Action within five (5) business days after receipt of the Settlement Amount.
edits.name: Release and dismissal

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms and existence of this Agreement, settlement communications, and the Settlement Amount are strictly confidential and shall not be disclosed by Plaintiff except: (a) to Plaintiff’s attorneys, accountants, tax advisors, insurers, auditors, or immediate family members who have a need to know and are informed of the confidentiality obligation; (b) as required by law, court order, subpoena, or governmental process, provided that Plaintiff gives Defendant prompt written notice to the extent legally permitted so Defendant may seek appropriate protection; (c) to enforce this Agreement; or (d) as necessary for tax reporting. If asked about the resolution, Plaintiff may state only that the matter has been resolved to the parties’ mutual satisfaction.
edits.name: Confidentiality with standard carve-outs

edits.text: 4. NO ADMISSION. This Agreement, the payment of the Settlement Amount, and any negotiations or communications concerning settlement are not, and shall not be construed as, an admission of liability, fault, wrongdoing, or damages by Defendant, all of which are expressly denied.
edits.name: No admission

edits.text: 5. NON-DISPARAGEMENT. Plaintiff shall not make, publish, or communicate any false or disparaging statement concerning Defendant or its products, services, officers, directors, employees, or business practices. Nothing in this paragraph restricts truthful statements required by law or made in legal proceedings.
edits.name: Add non-disparagement

edits.text: 6. AUTHORITY; VOLUNTARY AGREEMENT. Each person signing this Agreement represents that they have authority to bind the party on whose behalf they sign. Plaintiff represents that Plaintiff has read this Agreement, had the opportunity to consult counsel, understands its terms, and enters into it voluntarily and without coercion.
edits.name: Add authority and voluntary execution

edits.text: 7. GOVERNING LAW; ENFORCEMENT. This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of [State], without regard to conflict-of-law rules. The court in which the Action is pending shall retain jurisdiction, or the parties shall submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in [County, State], for purposes of enforcing this Agreement.
edits.name: Add governing law and enforcement

edits.text: 8. ENTIRE AGREEMENT; COUNTERPARTS. This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties concerning its subject matter and supersedes all prior or contemporaneous understandings concerning that subject matter. It may be executed in counterparts and by electronic signature, each of which is deemed an original and all of which together constitute one instrument.
edits.name: Add entire agreement and counterparts

edits.text: 4. MUTUAL AUTHORITY. Each person signing this Agreement represents and warrants that they have full authority to execute this Agreement on behalf of the party for whom they sign and to bind that party to all terms of this Agreement. Each party further represents that it has not assigned or transferred any claim released or affected by this Agreement.

edits.text: 5. NO ADMISSION. This Agreement reflects a compromise of disputed claims. Neither this Agreement, the payment of the Settlement Amount, nor any settlement communication shall be construed as an admission of liability, wrongdoing, fault, or violation of law by either party, all of which are expressly denied.
edits.name: No Admission

edits.text: 6. NON-DISPARAGEMENT. The parties agree not to make, publish, or communicate to any person or entity any false or disparaging statement concerning the other party, the Action, or the resolution of the Action. This provision does not prohibit truthful statements required by law, court order, subpoena, governmental inquiry, or other legal process, testimony under oath, communications with counsel or advisors, or statements necessary to enforce this Agreement.
edits.name: Non-Disparagement

edits.text: 7. ENFORCEMENT; FEES. The court presiding over the Action shall retain jurisdiction to enforce this Agreement to the extent permitted by law, or, if retention is unavailable, any party may bring an action to enforce this Agreement in a court of competent jurisdiction. In any action or proceeding to enforce this Agreement or remedy a breach, the prevailing party shall be entitled to recover its reasonable attorneys’ fees and costs, in addition to any other available relief.
edits.name: Enforcement; Fees

edits.text: 8. ENTIRE AGREEMENT; COUNTERPARTS. This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties concerning its subject matter and supersedes all prior or contemporaneous understandings concerning that subject matter. It may be executed in counterparts and by electronic signature, each of which is deemed an original and all of which together constitute one instrument.
edits.name: Entire Agreement; Counterparts
